name: Destroyer
description: Destroyer's kit from Girls' Frontline 2 for your Helldiver: a leaping shotgunner who pays for her skills with her own health. Annihilation Directive (a leap, then a line and a cone of high-explosive rounds), Doom Barrage (a barrage of blasts ahead), Party Time (a leap that blasts the whole path and heals her) and Ammo Frenzy (at 3 Fang, one strike shared among every enemy in reach). The less health she has the harder she hits; Sangvis Ferri makes her stronger against Automatons; Denied Exit saves her from one killing hit. Her hands: every weapon held in one hand, and a grenade launcher's grenades arm at once and home. Her body: more health and stamina, and a Hellbomb if she ever runs her stamina dry (can be turned off). Solo or host. Needs the HellForge 0.5 nightly. Keys in destroyer.ini; her numbers on the character kits' options screen (F9). HUD needs Bingus Shared Loader and HD2Runtime. Installs beside the author's other character kits. No character model included.
